input.summary: Lumen Peptide Trading Pte. Ltd. (V04), a trader; material made by partner plants in China and Korea. Earlier reply (Jasper): OTIF 97%, rejection 0.5% (no records, new in India), density ~1.03 for both peptide solutions (temperature not stated), ISO 9001 at manufacturer level, SDS to follow, 2 Singapore references. New reply: rosemary extract (RM-008) is 20% carnosic acid and about 8% rosmarinic acid by HPLC, which does not meet our 20% rosmarinic acid spec. Escalated to buyer for a decision on acceptability and equivalent quantity. Open: RM-009 COA 812 ppm vs quoted 1,000 ppm (2 tries left). Outstanding knockouts: COA with batch/dates (B5), Cosmetics Rules 2020 suitability (H2), SDS with transport class (H1). Also unanswered: manufacturer name/country (A2), need-by 20 Dec 2026 (E3), OTIF period and definition (I1), rejection period/basis (G2), density temperature (C3). Follow-up email drafted for buyer review.

input.title: V04 Lumen: RM-008 rosemary extract does not meet spec
input.detail: Spec for RM-008 is 20% rosmarinic acid, 28 kg over 6 months. Vendor (Jasper, reply on RFx thread) says the grade is 20% carnosic acid and about 8% rosmarinic acid by HPLC. This is a material deviation from spec, so I have not asked the vendor for a substitute quantity. Decision needed: (a) reject RM-008 from this vendor, (b) accept a different grade with a re-quoted quantity (for reference, matching 28 kg of 20% rosmarinic acid would be about 70 kg at 8%, a 2.5x conversion, to be confirmed by the vendor), or (c) ask for a different rosemary source. Please advise before the vendor is told.

input.subject: RFx KPC-2026-014 – RM-009 COA conflict and outstanding documents
input.body:
Dear Jasper,

Thank you for your reply. We still need the following before we can evaluate your quote.

1. RM-009 Copper Tripeptide-1 solution: the COA you sent shows 812 ppm, while your quote states 1,000 ppm. Please confirm the peptide strength of the material you would supply and send a COA for that batch that states the strength clearly.

2. Certificate of Analysis for a recent batch of each line (RM-001 to RM-010), showing batch number, manufacturing date and expiry or retest date. This is mandatory.

3. Current Safety Data Sheet for each line, including transport hazard class. This is mandatory. Please send it now rather than later.

4. Confirm that each material is suitable for leave-on scalp cosmetic use and permitted under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020. This is mandatory.

5. Manufacturer: name and country of manufacture for each line, since you are quoting as a trader.

6. Can you meet our first need-by date of 20 December 2026 for the first delivery? If not, state your earliest date.

7. Your OTIF rate of 97%: please state the period covered and your definition of on-time.

8. Your rejection rate of 0.5%: please state the period and basis used.

9. Density of the two peptide solutions: please state the temperature at which the density of about 1.03 g/mL applies.

Please reply by 14 November 2026, or tell us by then when you expect to send the outstanding items.

Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
